summary: One-hour pause-point checklist (READ-DO or DO-CONFIRM) of 5-9 killer items per pause-point that an architect + delivery manager run on a fixed-price proposal before send; every item has an executor + artefact + killer-anchor + quarterly review.

assumes_loaded.why: The sibling weekly margin scan whose alerts feed this proposal review.
Proposals decompose into WBS leaves; killer-items reference WBS IDs.
CR template used when red-team finds scope holes mid-engagement.
